text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, that running form...
Looks like Ruler-senpai still isn't in top shape.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Still, that is precisely why—!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (Tch, I'm making way more mistakes than usual.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (In the past, something like this would have demoralized me, but—)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (In your words, winning from behind like this is what makes it "fun," right?)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Then behold my playmaking!
Daaaaaaahhhhhhh!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rulership wins!!
She has conquered the Spring Grand Prix
for the revival!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
*huff, puff*... Does this at least...
pay back a little of what happened in Dubai...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "Winning today wasn't because... I grasped some profound revelation. The reason is—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's the "support effect"... from the off-track units.
In a race that seemed unwinnable... we won.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, in the end... I have no choice but to
win through these races as a game, huh...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Then that's what I'll do!
...From here on out, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki's cheers gave Rulership
a kind of carefree defiance.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay!! We did it, we did it!
Trainer, we did it!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Another fantastic chapter has been born.
I shall reread it over and over. And then..."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely gonna use that as reference!
Once I debut, I'll put on races just as exciting!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki isn't just enjoying the race.
She's carefully treating Rulership's performance as a model to learn from...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, both of you think so too, right?
How was it, coming to watch?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Gosh, that was so thrilling!
As expected of Kiseki-san's mentor in spirit.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: You're right! I think I'll learn from this too! Now, let's cheer. Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Good work, Ruler-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hm, those two next to Kiseki are...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an unfamiliar face.
They seemed to be an acquaintance of Kiseki, but...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I haven't introduced them yet, have I?
These two are from Tracen Academy...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: We're the "Thunder God Sisters"!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that's just what I took the liberty of calling them, though.
Come on, introduce yourself.

text_block_list.name: Thunder God Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We are the Thunder Sisters.
Kiseki-san gave us that nickname!

text_block_list.name: Thunder God Sister B
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to working with you!
Both of us are...

text_block_list.name: Thunder God Sisters
text_block_list.text: I really look up to you, Ruler-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm not the only one who's
completely captivated by your races, Ruler-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"These Thunder God Sisters said they want to follow your example, too.
They want to run just like that."
choice_data_list: I see... So that's how it is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There seems to be an undeniable charm to Rulership's running
that draws in her juniors.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: The support units... have increased?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"This is also Kiseki's influence...
It might be the bandwagon effect."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Just as expected... it has begun.

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Congrats, Ruler-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"A victory party...
I'm not really used to these kinds of
extroverted social gatherings, but..."
choice_data_list: Now, now, since we're already here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Swept up by the chorus of "Let's do it! Let's party!", the celebration for winning the Takarazuka Kinen begins.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The three—Kiseki and the Raijin Sisters—were beside themselves with excitement, surrounding the Rulership they looked up to so much.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah, we somehow managed to win this time, but...
that doesn't mean our problems are solved yet.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "Unlike those Umamusume with unbreakable mental fortitude, I really don't do well with serious stuff..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That trait itself cannot be changed.
That is why—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Instead of changing one's nature, one must become a bigger person—unshakable even in times of crisis.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oooh, a giant me...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Putting detailed planning aside for a moment...
Trainer, which stage should I head for
to make my presence known once again?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next target race. To make a victory
at the Takarazuka Kinen shine even brighter—
choice_data_list: Win the "Arima Kinen" too, and conquer both the Spring and Autumn Grand Prix races.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The "Arima Kinen", is it?
Winning both Grand Prix in a single year would certainly be a shining achievement.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I want to win somehow and make a full comeback, but...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The Spring-Autumn Grand Prix sweep, huh.
You can definitely do it, Ruler-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Ruler-senpai!
Is there anything we can do to help!?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: To you...?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I want to learn a lot by assisting
Ruler-senpai, and besides...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "If there's anything I can do to help, I'd love to lend a hand!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Lend my strength, huh.
Nothing comes to mind right away, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Very well. Kiseki, Raijin Sisters.
From now on, you will ride with me."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really?!
Woohoo!!!

text_block_list.name: Thunder God Sisters
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rulership, who usually weighs the pros and cons carefully, made a split-second decision, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind. It saves me the trouble of finding a board game
opponent during the summer training camp anyway. Besides—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This is likely... divine providence.
A blessing from the Game Master.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A game that you and I have played with just the two of us
has finally received its first major expansion pack.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I feel like this could be the game changer
for us while we're stuck in this rut.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, Trainer.
From here on—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—Let's change it.
Our campaign, that is.
